QUOTE: "Otherwise they expand to plain `calloc` / `free`." (conditional on MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY on); also "`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` defaults to off"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that with the default (memory off) the library dispatches through function pointers in platform.c. That is the opposite of the item's claim that a default build has no indirection and the macros expand directly to calloc/free.
